tasks.label: Build and sync assets
args: Set-Location '${workspaceFolder}'; if (!(Test-Path '.\sabotage_station\bin\assets')) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path '.\sabotage_station\bin\assets' -Force | Out-Null }; Copy-Item -Recurse -Force '.\sabotage_station\src\assets\*' '.\sabotage_station\bin\assets\'
